title: ½ Price Connoisseur Ice Cream Tub Varieties 1L $6.50 @ Coles
body:
Deal: ½ Price Connoisseur Ice Cream Tub Varieties 1L $6.50 @ Coles

[safwanc] The texture and flavour has gone really downhill in the last year in my experience. I wouldn't recommend it even if it was on sale for $3-4.
This is not the same ice cream I used to love (cookies & cream, caramal macadamia) precovid.
[gviddy] People are however continuing to buy it, full price continues to increase.
[liam2040] Yup, full price advertised as $14 at Woolworths today.
[Kommodore] @liam2040: Yeah stuff is going up non-stop still and people keep buying, covid taught these companies people are bigger suckers than they thought. On top of the legitimate fuel/supply chain inflation.
I know there are cashed up boomers and rich people, but they aren't buying lots of junk food generally, there has to be a point where this comes to a head.
[luvyrselfish] Haven't been able to have Cafe Grande for a while.
[KangaDrew] That's because it was discontinued a few months back.
[DealHunted] Oh, I was wondering why I couldn't find it. That was my go to, now I go for Belgian chocolate.
[illusion99] They use High Fructose Syrup - not ideal. I mean ice cream is just cream milk sugar eggs and whatever flavouring/toppings. No need for all these other ingredients just so you can reduce the amount of those real ingredients
[richy_o] When did they change to high fructose corn syrup? I didn't think anything in Australia used it as sugar was so cheap. Very strange.
[liam2040] You'd think that, but i recently discovered the Kirks range of cool drinks have reduced their sugar content by 10% and added sweeteners in it's place. So it's now 90% of the sugar PLUS the added sweeteners. You can guess the motive behind the move. We are knee deep in the era of enshitification now.
[Agileduck] Ah Cookies & Cream gets the thumbnail, as it should be, the best flavour has been confirmed!!
[Plasma] Yeah it's not as good as it once was (anyone actually have the ingredients list from 5+ years ago?) but it's still more than decent at half price.
[gviddy] Will higher interest rates cause this icecream to drop from $13 ? Or will it continue to climb to $15 by the end of the year?
[sschen] We stopped buying this as well as quite a few popular brands such as Peters, Magnum, Blue Ribbon, Streets etc that no longer use fresh milk cream (mostly reconstituted/concentrate crap) in their ice cream after watching the videos below. We mainly buy Bulla Ice Cream now.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nLDYUHbg_hM
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeKiS4NnDw0
[Dr-Bargain] I bought a few flavours to try from the last deal, and the taste is almost sugary milk, although they are different in flavours. It's very light but sweet. Now I'm stuck with all these 1L tubs that'll take months for me to finish. Maybe I'll throw them out. Huggindas is my favourite so far. Ben & Jerry's is also good
